name: gestao-pos-venda
description: Sistema de Gestão do Pós-Venda — Maranhão Motos (monorepo: apps/api + apps/web)
author: BergeS7

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run build
